crosswalk.rule: Objective-first and optional advanced paths; revalidate comprehension and existing model-picker behavior.
Truthful operation display; browser-native and host-mediated remain distinct.
Retain source admission, lineage, research quality limitations and revision evidence.
Measure exact-head, distinguish lab from deployed telemetry.
Public HTTPS, neutral conformance, security and distribution obligations remain separate.
Preserve atomic revision, failure recovery and integrated CI.
